# World Economic Forum

> The World Economic Forum provides strategic insights on global challenges including AI transformation, geopolitics, corporate strategy, and inclusive growth for leaders and organizations.

The World Economic Forum is a global platform for leaders to address pressing world issues. This site features analysis and guidance on organizational transformation, geopolitical dynamics, diversity and inclusion, and leadership strategies shaping the global economy.

## Key Topics

- AI Transformation
- Davos 2026
- Corporate Strategy
- Geopolitics
- Organizational Change
- Gender Equality
- Global Cooperation
- Economic Growth
- Diversity and Inclusion
- Enterprise AI Adoption
- Global Risks
- Leadership
- People's Prosperity
- Geopolitical Shocks
- Business Innovation

## Davos 2026 & Global Leadership

- [Davos 2026: Strengthening global cooperation in a contested world](https://www.weforum.org/stories/2026/01/we-asked-leaders-davos-2026-how-can-cooperate-more-contested-geopolitical-world-heres-what-they-said): Davos 2026 coverage on global cooperation and multilateral solutions to geopolitical challenges
- [How can we better invest in people's prosperity, health, skills and jobs? Davos 2026](https://www.weforum.org/stories/2026/01/leaders-davos-2026-how-can-we-invest-in-peoples-prosperity-health-skills-and-jobs): Davos 2026 insights on investing in people amid inequality, AI disruption, and declining trust
- [Leadership](https://www.weforum.org/stories/leadership): Collection of leadership stories featuring guidance on inspiring others and achieving goals

## AI Transformation & Organizational Change

- [Organizational Transformation in the Age of AI: How Organizations Maximize AI's Potential](https://www.weforum.org/publications/organizational-transformation-in-the-age-of-ai-how-organizations-maximize-ais-potential): Guide on embedding AI across operations, R&D, and talent for organizational transformation
- [Redefining corporate strategy in a more volatile world](https://www.weforum.org/stories/2026/03/how-corporate-strategy-is-changing-in-a-world-of-constant-shocks): Corporate strategy insights on dynamic planning amid geopolitical, AI, and energy shocks

## Geopolitics & Global Economics

- [The global price tag of war in the Middle East](https://www.weforum.org/stories/2026/03/the-global-price-tag-of-war-in-the-middle-east): Analysis of Iran conflict's cascading economic impacts on global markets and supply chains
- [Geo-Economics and Politics](https://www.weforum.org/stories/geo-economics-and-politics): Stories analyzing global dynamics shaping international relations, trade, and geopolitics

## Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

- [Experts Explain: Why does the gender gap persist?](https://www.weforum.org/videos/expert-explains-why-gender-gap-persists): Expert analysis on persistent gender gaps using 2025 Global Gender Gap Report findings
- [Equity, Diversity and Inclusion](https://www.weforum.org/stories/equity-diversity-and-inclusion): Stories on embedding equity, diversity, and inclusion practices for social justice

## Business & Innovation

- [Business](https://www.weforum.org/stories/business): Business innovation and growth stories covering entrepreneurship, strategy, and sustainability
